The person's face exhibits significant anatomical anomalies, including a wide, unnatural grin with fused teeth and distorted facial structure. The menu is held in the foreground, displaying columns of text and prices, but the text itself is largely illegible gibberish.

The menu pages warp unnaturally, and the background geometry (tiles/wall) bends inconsistently with the camera angle.
The skin has a waxy, overly smooth texture, and the hair blends into the background without distinct strand definition.
